title.narrative: Facilitating Public, Private and CSOs Partnership and Dialogue for effective youth employment through systemic change

description.narrative:
The project is part of the EU CSF Plus Program titled “Strengthening the Capacities of Grassroots CSOs in Ethiopia.” It aims to achieve the following key objectives:
Support the development and adoption of standardized BDS guidelines and submit the finalized guidelines to policymakers for approval by the end of 2026. Establish and operationalize a unified and accessible digital youth employment knowledge and resource hub in Arba Minch, serving at least 100 youth (70% women) and 20 youth employment actors by 2026. Carry out targeted lobbying and advocacy efforts to create an enabling environment that improves access to essential services—including finance, markets, and Business Development Services (BDS)—for 100 youth (70% women) by 2026. Implement a youth employment monitoring system in Arba Minch to track job creation outcomes and scale effective practices in collaboration with 20 local ecosystem actors.
